reassignments.rationale: Pinned-browser ICC matrix (tests/oracle/jpeg-icc): the reference ignores malformed and incomplete ICC sequences and draws the untagged image; the owner judges every such row against the reference drawing in all formats with exact reports, extents, alpha, SVG octets and replay. Criterion rewritten from strict recovery (policy chosen on #85). See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.

owners.rationale: JPEG malformed facet: 32 reference rows (tests/oracle/jpeg-container): trailing data, junk and fill bytes, unknown and oversized application segments, stray RST/TEM, missing DHT, a progressive file missing only its EOI and corrupt entropy pass the canonical comparison with the reference in PNG and PDF with SVG octets preserved; truncated scans, a baseline file missing its EOI, a missing DQT and a restart interval without its markers (the declared partial-paint divergence) and reference-rejected files recover exactly; plus the malformed-marker, trailing-data/ICC-sequence and approved strict MPF recovery suites. See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.

JPEG default-frame facet: 9 reference rows: the first image draws; appended images, EXIF IFD1 and JFXX thumbnails and non-hdrgm gain-map containers are data after it; plus valid SDR-base MPF gain maps drawing their base as the reference does. See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.

JPEG orientation facet: 22 reference rows: EXIF orientations 1-8 in both byte orders, out-of-range values, other tag types and counts, IFD1-only and XMP-only orientation ignored, EXIF over XMP, the Exif header fill-byte variant and a looping IFD on YCbCr, gray and CMYK; plus the 164-row EXIF precedence record suites and the native all-orientation and invalid-TIFF suites. See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.

JPEG color-profile facet: 11 reference rows (sRGB-equivalent snapping, P3/linear on RGB and gray, mismatched and truncated profiles ignored, JFIF over Adobe transform and component identifiers); plus the JPEG ICC record (accepted, malformed and incomplete sequences drawn untagged, gray precision and model mismatches, multipart) and the JPEG color record (gray/RGB/YCbCr cells, CMYK and YCCK conversion). The #187 baseline sampling cells remain separate gaps. See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.

JPEG HDR gain-map facet: ISO 21496-1 and GContainer-only containers draw the primary image as the reference does; valid SDR-base MPF + hdrgm containers draw their base; invalid indexes and framing keep the approved strict recovery (declared divergence); HDR-base projection is the known #190 divergence pinned to its exact output (the eight #190 cells remain separate gaps). See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.
JPEG passthrough facet: direct SVG embeds the exact source octets of every row the reference draws in the 65-row record, and recovers exactly for the rest. See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.

JPEG alpha facet: every admitted row of the 65-row record, across YCbCr, gray and CMYK, markers and orientations, draws fully opaque in PNG and PDF (no soft-mask transparency; CMYK K is never alpha). See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.

JPEG limits facet: byte, dimension, pixel and work equality and first crossing with exact reports and missing-asset recovery for baseline, progressive, CMYK, EXIF-rotated and SDR gain-map JPEGs in every format, and the 13.2 multi-crossing precedence on oriented dimensions. See docs/research/jpeg-umbrella-facets.md.
